description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala  District - Cad. Map No.420201 (24/0929)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and land registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and property rights - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
